# langsmith_tagging (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith tagging, which associates a tag value with a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_tagging" "example" {
  tag_value_id  = langsmith_tag_value.example.id
  resource_type = "project"
  resource_id   = langsmith_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) The ID of the resource to tag.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of resource to tag. Valid values: `alert`, `dashboard`, `dataset`, `deployment`, `experiment`, `project`, `prompt`, `queue`.
- `tag_value_id` (String) The ID of the tag value to apply.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the tagging.
